description: Private metasearch engine (JSON API) — the web_search backend for ComfyUI Studio.
fullDescription:
## OVERVIEW ##
SearXNG is a privacy-respecting metasearch engine that aggregates results from many search services without tracking you. This build runs it as a private, in-cluster API for ComfyUI Studio's web_search tool — no data leaves your machine to a third-party search account.

- JSON output is enabled (required by the Studio web_search tool).
- The rate-limiter / bot-detection is disabled so Studio's programmatic requests aren't blocked (safe: the instance is private, not public).
- The session secret_key is generated at install (never stored in the app package).

## USE IT ##
After install, open ComfyUI Studio -> Settings -> Tools and set the SearXNG URL to:
  http://searxng.<your-namespace>.svc.cluster.local:8080
That enables the web_search tool in chat. No API key is required.
